topbar.reset.title: Reset · stops everything and clears (asks for confirmation)
reset.confirm.title: Stop everything and clear?
reset.confirm.body: All running processes will be STOPPED (browser searches, SlowBrain tasks, widget creation), observability will be cleared and the desktop left blank. Your memory and your credentials (WhatsApp/Telegram/browser) will NOT be touched unless you check the boxes below.
reset.confirm.wipeMemory: Also wipe MEMORY (your name, everything it knows about you — short and long term)
reset.confirm.wipeCredentials: Also wipe widget CREDENTIALS (WhatsApp, Telegram, browser session)
reset.confirm.hint: Checking either one restarts the server automatically (a few seconds).
restarting.title: Restarting zaelar…
restarting.body: Wiping what you selected and starting over. This takes a few seconds — the page will reload itself as soon as it's ready again.
i18n.preparing.sub: First time in this language — setting up the interface. This only happens once.
